title: Gold Rush
description:
S16 E15 — Trommel Around and Find Out
Tony blows up at Mike to get the trommel running; two of Rick's crew face off while trying to dig out Valhalla; Kevin leans on Buzz to get more gold.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S16 E16 — The Silence of the Sluice
Parker does the unthinkable to get all the Golden Mile's pay dirt; Rick's mechanic Ryan considers leaving; Mike Beets finally fires up the trommel on the hill.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S16 E17 — Rick's Mess
Rick's shaken by his find at the bottom of Valhalla; Tony bears down on his 6,500-ounce goal; Parker taps Brennan for a big job at the Golden Mile.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S16 E18 — Golden Goose, Wounded Moose
Tony spends millions on a new piece of ground for Mike; Parker buys a Golden Goose to turn the season around; Kevin struggles with a recent hire.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S16 E19 — Dig Deep or Cash Out
Rick returns to Vegas and gets a proposition from Parker; Tony hunts for missed gold in the Hester Cut; Parker's crew loses a truck at the worst time.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S16 E20 — Musical Washplants
Parker brings Sluicifer out of retirement for a big week. Rick prays that Vegas Valley still pays out big. Kevin staffs up for the final push.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S16 E21 — 1,000-Ounce Week
Tony guns for over 1,000 ounces in one week; Parker buys a new toy to open even more ground; Rick's crew burns through pay following a hot streak.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S16 E22 — The Gold Ceiling
Parker and Tony both try to bust through the 10,000-ounce barrier; Rick tries to get the Last Chance cut open before he runs out of Vegas Valley pay dirt.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S16 E23 — Klondike Shoot-Out
Parker battles Tony in an intense showdown for the year's top gold haul; Rick grinds at Lightning Creek and expands his operation to save his season.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E01 — The Most Gold Wins
Parker and Tony set 13,000-ounce gold totals, sparking a battle to see who can mine the most and reigniting an old feud; Rick faces health issues and an uncertain future; a new player enters the Klondike fray.

title: Gold Rush: Mine Rescue With Freddy & Juan
description:
S06 E08 — Double Trouble
A familiar miner in Alaska desperately needs 150 ounces of gold to save their operation; when Juan learns that their landowner's mine is halfway to $1M in the hole, he and Gold Rush legend Dave Turin face their first-ever double rescue.

title: Ghost Adventures: House Calls
description:
S03 E05 — Insidious in Indiana
Zak's team lands in the Hangman's corner neighborhood of Seymour, Indiana, to answer a call from a desperate family; with the spiritual activity becoming more aggressive by the day, the guys race to find answers before someone is seriously injured.

title: Auction Kings
description:
S01 E01 — Vampire Hunting Kit; Meteorite
Gallery 63 owner Paul Brown verifies a vampire killing kit; Jon finds a signed edition of Gone with the Wind and a WWII Nazi Handbook on his first test run; a hopeful seller brings in a Russian meteorite.

title: Live to Farm
description:
S04 E01 — To Bee or Not to Bee
It's watermelon planting season! The Cardinal family shows us the importance of pollination using honey bees, and provides a tour of their farming operation. Kevin's equipment seems to break down at the worst time possible.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
Ferreting Out the Problem
Each year, CBP officers inspect thousands of animals, including family pets and exotic wildlife -- because at the border, the threat may come from a different species. Some look innocent, while others carry hidden dangers.

title: Major League Fishing
description:
Stage Seven Championship Round: Lake Erie
The Stage Seven Championship Round of Major League Fishing's Bass Pro Tour from Sandusky, OH, where the final 10 anglers compete for the trophy and a top prize of $125,000.

title: Moonshiners
description:
S16 E01 — Life, Liberty and Tax-free Liquor
Demand spikes for Tim and Tickle's duty-free shine, but big profits breed competition in the Virginia backwoods; Mark and Digger buy 90,000 bushels of surplus corn, but must run stills 24/7 to empty the grain silos in 60 days.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S03 E07 — Cracking the D.B. Cooper Case
Josh Gates sets off on an expedition to crack the mystery behind the perpetrator of the only unsolved plane hijacking in U.S. history.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S04 E04 — The Secret
Josh travels across the United States to find the treasures featured in the cryptic 1982 book "The Secret"; Josh meets with members of the book's cult following, who each think they are on the verge of locating one of the 10 remaining treasures.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S10 E06 — The Bootlegger's Millions
Josh Gates chases the lost fortune of Prohibition's infamous bootlegger Dutch Schultz; Josh dives the murky shore near Dutch's lavish New York mansion and searches the underground bunker that housed his secret distillery.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S12 E05 — Chasing Bonnie and Clyde
Tracking America's most infamous couple, Josh teams up with a former FBI agent to scour a legendary Bonnie and Clyde hideout; then Josh hits the road on a 700-mile trip through the heartland to the site of the outlaw duo's most notorious shootout.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S10 E05 — Knights Templar Treasure Hunt
Josh digs in to unearth the secret world of the Knights Templar, the legendary warriors rumored to have amassed vast riches and treasures, including the coveted Holy Grail; Josh joins an excavation of a rare Templar gravesite in Eastern Europe.

title: Expedition Unknown
description:
S11 E06 — Hunt for Spain's King Arthur
Plunging hundreds of feet below ground, Josh explores Spain's treacherous La Garma cave system and finds a floor littered with human remains more than 1,000 years old; Josh's deep dive is a quest for scientific proof of Spain's legendary King Pelayo.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S15 E03 — No Gear, No Fear
A backpacker and experienced hunter attempt to survive 21 days in a swampy Argentine savanna teeming with mosquitoes and violent subtropical storms.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S18 E02 — Couch to Cave
A superfan teams with a supermom to take on the jungles of Mexico's Yucatán Peninsula for 14 days. Battling brutal storms, ravenous bats and unrelenting hunger, they must rely on sheer grit to survive this fan challenge.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S17 E11 — Poison Control
Crippled by injuries and toxic frogs, an adrenaline junkie and a self-proclaimed renaissance redneck must dig deep to try to endure 21 days in Colombia.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S18 E03 — Return of the King
Legend Steven Lee Hall Jr. joins two first-time survivalists for 21 days in the brutal backwoods of Kentucky; its deadly copperheads and violent storms push even the King of the Forest to his breaking point.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S15 E01 — Welcome to America!
Two foreigners try to become the first survivalists to endure 21 days on U.S. soil; rattlesnakes, unfamiliar terrain and plummeting temperatures threaten to send them back across the pond.

title: Naked and Afraid

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S20 E07 — Forged in Fury
As the first Siberian storm slams the grounds, Sig sets into 40-knot winds, risking capsizing when his tank floods; Sophia must prove she can drive a boat and lead her crew in severe weather while Jake battles insubordination from his own new crew.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S20 E08 — Seaborne Sacrifice
Sig deploys tactics from the old country to zero in on the Bairdi crab mother lode; Jack earns a windfall of new quota, but it comes at the cost of drug testing his crew.

title: How to Catch a Dirtbag
description:
S01 E01 — The Tesla Terrorizer
A woman is caught on camera defecating on a car; a man makes off with a tow truck, wreaking havoc through the streets of New York City.

title: Jeff Dunham's the Cars That Drove Us
description:
S01 E04 — Corvette
Before becoming America's Sports Car, the Chevrolet Corvette was the bane of General Motors' existence.

title: The RVers
description: Exploring all aspects of the nomadic lifestyle embraced by people who travel in recreational vehicles.

title: Jeff Dunham's the Cars That Drove Us
description:
S01 E06 — Hummer
As the American military outgrows the Jeep, it needs something strong, tough, more versatile, and the Humvee is the answer; from Desert Storm to Rodeo Drive, it became America's vehicle of choice, courtesy of its big fan, Arnold Schwarzenegger.

title: RV There Yet?
description:
S05 E05 — Howard, PA
Patrice and Kevin McCabe camp at Bald Eagle State Park in Howard, Pennsylvania; later, they visit Penn State University and Penn's Cave.

title: Gold Rush
description:
S17 E01 — The Most Gold Wins
Parker and Tony set 13,000-ounce gold totals, sparking a battle to see who can mine the most and reigniting an old feud; Rick faces health issues and an uncertain future; a new player enters the Klondike fray.

title: Secret Life of a Vegas Casino
description:
S01 E01 — The Good, the Bad and the Unlucky
As the Golden Nugget's busiest season begins, tempers flare at check-in; a swiped $1,000 chip sparks a hotel-wide high-tech hunt; surveillance targets a team of card counters; and a VIP host gets creative to keep his client gambling.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S01 E01 — Washington Parish Jail
Over-capacity and on the brink, Louisiana's Washington Parish Jail is spiraling into chaos; the new sheriff struggles to bring stability and control while facing the mistakes of the past.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S01 E06 — Bristol County Jail
In Bristol County Jail, half of the cells don't lock; as changing demographics bring in more violent, gang-affiliated criminals, staff must manage a higher-risk population without the facility slipping into chaos.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S01 E07 — Butler County Jail
Inside Butler County Jail, a six-term sheriff and his seasoned staff confront an opioid crisis; as drugs flood the facility, officers work to dismantle the supply ring and maintain order.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E09 — Indian River County Jail
On Florida's Treasure Coast, home to some of the priciest real estate in the state, Indian River County Jail serves the people who wealth left behind. Deputies invest in programs, mentorship and second chances to keep them from coming back.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E07 — Anderson County Jail
Anderson County, Tennessee, is federally recognized as an area affected by drug trafficking and gangs. With only one county jail, Sheriff Barker and his team combat crime while offering unique inmate reentry programs that reduce recidivism.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E11 — Tennessee Dyer County Jail
At Tennessee's Dyer County Jail, overcrowding, contraband and violence strain an understaffed facility, where drugs have been smuggled in by officers and violence among inmates has turned deadly.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E03 — Monster in Michigan
When a rare EF-3 tornado touches down in northern Michigan, cameras capture the chaos and disbelief.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E02 — That Car's Flying!
Hurricane Idalia sweeps away coastal homes and flips a car 350 miles away.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E08 — Jamaica Category 5
Tourists and locals endure catastrophic winds and flooding as Category 5 Hurricane Melissa tears across Jamaica; as guests scramble to take shelter, resorts in Montego Bay suffer structural failure, while torrential rain inundates Black River.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E12 — The 40-State Storm
In January 2026, a 2000-mile winter storm unleashes chaos across 40 states; a 100-car pileup traps motorists in Michigan, a freight train smashes a stranded semi and first responders race to save a driver sinking in a frozen pond.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S04 E13 — Three Rivers, Four Tornadoes
A lone supercell thunderstorm in March 2026 spawns unexpected late winter tornadoes in the upper Midwest, including the earliest-ever EF-3 tornado to hit Michigan.

title: In the Eye of the Storm
description:
S02 E03 — Helene's Appalachian Hellscape
Hurricane Helene barrels north into Appalachia, dumping 30 inches of rain; as hundreds of cameras capture flooding and mudslides, one woman gets swept away by the deluge, until a man attending a wedding rehearsal jumps into the water to save her.

title: Truck Dynasty
description:
S01 E04 — Hummer, but Make It Bigger
A repeat client wants a tall, big work truck, so the team decides to build the world's first-ever, lifted Hummer EV; Ashley sets a company sales goal of 25 trucks at the upcoming Palm Beach Boat Show, sparking family tension.

title: Deadliest Catch
description:
S20 E09 — A Wrinkle in Time
Johnathan alters time in an attempt to get to port for an anniversary he promised Heather on land; Rick battles a Bering Sea gale that knocks his deckhand out of commission; Sophia helms the Seabrooke in the roughest weather she's ever seen.

title: Airplane Repo
description:
S01 E02 — Spies in the Night
Mike braves a potential suicide mission in California; Kevin is at the mercy of a mechanic and a windy night.

title: Airplane Repo
description:
S01 E04 — Narrow Escape
Mike braves gators in Florida to retrieve a Cessna Float plane; Ken and Danny have an encounter with an angry debtor.

title: Airplane Repo
description:
S01 E10 — Repo Roulette
Mike Kennedy sky-dives into an airfield in a bid to snatch a de Havilland Twin Otter; Ken Cage and Danny Thompson attempt a risky two-vehicle snatch.

title: Airplane Repo
description:
S01 E09 — Flying Blind
Ken Cage tries to repossess two high-end yachts in just two days; Kevin Lacey attempts a white-knuckle landing on a runway with no lights.

title: How It's Made
description:
S30 E12 — Aerospace Fasteners; Cactus Pear Puree; Lab Reactors
Aerospace fasteners; cactus pear purée; lab reactors.

title: How It's Made
description:
S27 E03 — Graphene, World's Smallest Car; Force Testers; Composite Cans
Curious minds find out how things like graphene, the world's smallest car, force testers and composite cars are manufactured.

title: How It's Made
description:
S31 E05 — Mountain Bike Tyres; Leaf/Debris Vacuums; Canned Meat
Mountain bike tires; leaf and debris vacuums; canned meat; fillet knives.

title: How It's Made
description:
S29 E09 — Foosball Tables; Marseille Soap; Laguiole Pocket Knives
How foosball tables, Marseille soap and Laguiole pocket knives are made.

title: How It's Made
description:
S29 E06 — Fireplace Bellows; Calissons; Diving Watercraft
Following how fireplace bellows, calissons and recreational watercraft are made.

title: How It's Made
description:
S32 E13 — Peaked Caps; Custom Water Heaters; Electric Boats; Fencing Foils
Find out how peaked caps, custom water heaters, electric boats and fencing foils are made.

title: How It's Made
description:
S31 E08 — Educational Robots; Boxing Belts; Boat Radar Mounts
Educational robots; boxing belts; boat radar mounts; European-style radiators.

title: How It's Made
description:
S31 E06 — Rice Cookers; Concealment Furniture
Rice cookers; concealment furniture; promotional origami; hedge shears.

title: How It's Made
description:
S27 E12 — Race Car Oil Tanks, Plaster Moldings, Lemongrass Oil, and Fly Tying Vises
Learning how race car oil, plaster moldings, lemongrass oil and fly tying vices are made.

title: How It's Made
description:
S31 E03 — Spinning Reels; Plasma Protein Therapies; 3D Cups
Exploring the production processes of everyday items, including spinning reels, plasma protein therapies, 3D cups and stainless steel beer kegs.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S08 E06 — A Smuggler's Guide to Weight Loss
After a K9 alerts to a vehicle, officers have trouble finding anything, but eventually a secret compartment reveals its contents.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S08 E02 — Grab Bag
Officers find a man and his family driving a suspiciously modified truck; a young man is caught with narcotics strapped to his body; a crosser is detained for having a record of smuggling an illegal migrant across the border.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S09 E07 — A Drop in the Bouquet
Cartels hope CBP won't inspect happy families, but officers know not to fall for that smuggling trick. Due to avian flu, live chickens can't be brought into the U.S.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S09 E08 — Just Doing My Duty
Each year, CBP recovers over 1,300 stolen vehicles at ports of entry. Many are heading to the black market, while cartels use others for trafficking. When officers receive a be on the lookout (BOLO) alert for a luxury car, they take it seriously.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
S09 E09 — Boomers Behaving Badly
Tourist Day celebrates the thousands of Americans who migrate south during the winter months. With 11,000 visitors expected, officers are preparing themselves for festivities fueled by alcohol and drugs.

title: Contraband: Seized at the Border
description:
For Better ... or Worse
Millions of travelers cross the U.S. borders every year. And while some are innocent couples, others are partners in crime. Because at the border, love isn't always what it seems.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E12 — Loudoun County Adult Detention Center
In one of America's wealthiest counties, Loudoun County Adult Detention Center serves the wealthy and the impoverished alike by running rehab programs, chasing contraband, and giving every inmate — rich or poor — a shot at a brighter future.

title: 120 Hours Behind Bars
description:
S02 E11 — Tennessee Dyer County Jail
At Tennessee's Dyer County Jail, overcrowding, contraband and violence strain an understaffed facility, where drugs have been smuggled in by officers and violence among inmates has turned deadly.
